title: Replace Docling placeholder with real service profile

context.summary: Replace the Docling Compose placeholder with a real extraction service profile.
context.background: The optional Docling profile must start a real service with healthcheck and worker connectivity.

in: Replace the Docling placeholder service command with a real service/image profile.
Add Docling healthcheck, config and installer validation.
Wire worker extraction client to the Docling service endpoint.
Remove the unused placeholder service script if no other supported path needs it.
Remove TASK-92-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Full PDF extraction acceptance beyond service startup.

acceptance_criteria: docker-compose docling profile starts a real Docling-compatible service.
Installer validates Docling service health before enabling the profile.
Worker can call the configured Docling endpoint.
No supported Compose service uses the placeholder service script.

manual_checks: Confirm the docling profile has a real health endpoint.
Confirm the placeholder service script is deleted or unused by supported profiles.

risks: Docling image size and startup time may increase live acceptance duration.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
